title: Dormant Old Wallets Stir as Perp Funding Holds Negative
summary: On-chain sleuths flagged large movements from a decade-old cluster — while derivatives markets price in more downside.

body.p: Two developments crossed the desk overnight: a cluster of 2015-era wallets moved for the first time in years, and perpetual funding rates on major venues flipped negative.

body.quote: Funding negative means shorts are paying longs — a sign the crowded trade is bearish, which squeezes the other way fast.

body.p: Movement is not distribution. Coins often shift between custodial setups or consolidating addresses. On-chain data alone can't tell intent — but when combined with negative funding, traders read it as supply-overhang risk.
